purpose: Teach: コイツ/フラフラ/おととい/がまん/ちょこちょこ/まちまち/何時も/物凄く

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様を「コイツが小さい頃」って紹介されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, Aoi, that customer introduced his little one to me as 'this troublemaker when she was small'…
lines.style: Warm observation, slight laugh underneath. Conversational pace. The tone of someone noticing something fond about another person's habit.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、繁忙期、終わるとフラフラになっちゃうわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: When the rush finally ends, Aoi just kind of melts, doesn't she?
lines.style: Gentle wry humor, knowing smile in the voice. Not unkind — the observation of someone who sees both the exhaustion and the person behind it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、おとといから新メニューを出してたんだったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I noticed she's been running the new menu since the day before yesterday.
lines.style: Soft, noticing tone. Unhurried. The voice of someone keeping track of small details because they care.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、忙しい時もがまんして笑顔でいないとね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Even when it's hectic, she somehow keeps that smile going. That takes something.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. Steady, even pace. Recognition of effort without making it dramatic — just stating what she's witnessed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新人さんがちょこちょこミスしてるわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new girl's been making little mistakes here and there, though.
lines.style: Gentle, non-judgmental observation. Slight pause before 'mistakes' — not criticism, just noticing. Tender concern underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のご注文がまちまちで、覚えるの大変ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The orders come in all over the place, so it's a lot for her to keep track of.
lines.style: Understanding exhale. Knowing nod in the voice. The kind of comment that shows she's not blaming, just seeing what the real challenge is.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お得意様、何時もカウンター席ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Her regulars always seem to claim the same counter seats, don't they?
lines.style: Light, observant. The tone of someone noticing patterns and finding comfort in them. Slight warmth — these are Aoi's people.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、お客様に物凄く好評で嬉しいわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm so happy the new menu's going over so well with everyone.
lines.style: Genuine warmth radiating through. Soft, pleased smile in every word. Slow, satisfied pace — she's genuinely happy for Aoi.
